allow: Bash(python3 -c "import json;d=json.load\(open\('package.json'\)\);print\({k:v for k,v in {**d.get\('dependencies',{}\),**d.get\('devDependencies',{}\)}.items\(\) if 'mdx' in k or 'rehype' in k or 'remark' in k}\)")

hooks.command: p=$(npm run format:check 2>&1); pe=$?; l=$(npm run lint 2>&1); le=$?; p_label=$([ $pe -eq 0 ] && echo 'PASS' || echo 'FAIL'); l_label=$([ $le -eq 0 ] && echo 'PASS' || echo 'FAIL'); jq -cn --arg msg "Prettier: $p_label | ESLint: $l_label" '{systemMessage: $msg}'
